extracted.name: Almond Milk Chocolate Pudding
extracted.description: This almond milk pudding made with cocoa powder is super creamy and chocolaty. It's just as delicious as traditional chocolate pudding but it's dairy free.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup white sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: Whisk sugar, cocoa powder, cornstarch, and salt together in a saucepan off the stove. Add 1/4 cup almond milk; whisk until smooth and foamy. Continue adding almond milk, 1/4 cup at a time, whisking after each addition.
Place the saucepan over medium-high heat and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a simmer and starts to thicken, about 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in butter until melted and smooth. Stir in vanilla, then pour pudding into a serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate until chilled, at least 30 minutes.
